purpose: Versioned documentary annotations linked by inventory_id. They complement the national master without changing its rows or its validator. Read by scripts/phase2_inventory_completeness_reconcile.py.
rules: state is one of KNOWN, UNKNOWN, PENDING_VERIFICATION, CONFLICT, NOT_EVALUATED; an unknown value is never written as a negative one
KNOWN needs a source with institution, url or identifier, and read_status; geometry and outlet can never be set KNOWN here

coastal_connection values: COASTAL_IMPACT_DOCUMENTED (only with a VERIFIED source, its real SHA-256 and the archived file), COASTAL_IMPACT_CANDIDATE (with basis), COASTAL_IMPACT_UNKNOWN, COASTAL_IMPACT_NOT_ASSESSED (default for every row without annotation)
map_eligible, suggested_state, coordinates, thresholds, discharges or travel times are never annotated here
an annotation may target a row of an open PR delta (expected_in); it is applied only when that delta is loaded

annotations.basis: SIGRID 5841 prints 'quebrada El Establo 1 y El Establo 2' (singular 'quebrada'). PR #404 records two documentary identities by owner decision (2026-10-23, split_basis); whether they are two independent channels is not adjudicated.
Same record as ancash_chimbote_el_establo_1 (SIGRID 5841); independence not adjudicated.
SIGRID 5864 prints 's/n' (no individual name). One documentary mention; it does not prove a quebrada distinct from, or identical to, any other row.
SIGRID 5865 prints 's/n'. Being a different map from 5864 does not by itself prove a different channel.
